fact: Somali Public Agenda says that in late 2022 research Garowe, Qardho and Galkacyo had registered 20,000, 12,500 and 5,452 properties with plate numbers embedded in the local financial system, and that Puntland's four major local governments (Galkacyo north, Garowe, Qardho, Bosaso) use an FMIS, introduced in Garowe in 2019 and the others in 2021, while Galmudug and BRA districts have none.
title: Governance Brief 26
